req_desc: A public India storefront plus an authenticated console are served from one deployment ...
A `support` member may create a refund at or below a ceiling of `500000` paise ...
Authorization is enforced server-side on every mutating endpoint.
Every seeded account signs in with the password `deku-demo-pw-2026`.
Login at `POST /api/auth/login` returns a bearer access token ...
`GET /api/me` returns the signed-in person with every membership held.
`GET /api/accounts` returns only organisations the caller belongs to.
A member of one organisation reading another organisation's payment receives a not-found answer.
A console read defaults to the live environment when no environment parameter is given.
A sandbox payment identifier read under live is answered as not found.
A payment carries a refunded total computed from non-failed refunds.
A payment status is one of succeeded, partially_refunded, refunded, disputed.
A refund at or below the caller's ceiling writes a refund row at once ...
A refund above the caller's ceiling is refused with the code `approval_required` ...
Raising a refund request stores a mandatory justification ...
A pending refund request leaves every balance unchanged ...
The approval queue is ordered soonest to expire first.
Approving a request as the raiser is refused with the code `self_approval_forbidden` ...
Approving a pending request writes exactly one refund ...
Rejecting a request requires a note.
Withdrawing a request is permitted only to the requester who raised the request.
Approving an expired request is refused with the code `approval_expired` ...
A refund larger than the remaining refundable amount is refused with the code `amount_too_large`.
A refund of a disputed payment is refused with the code `payment_disputed`.
Two simultaneous approvals of one request produce exactly one refund.
Replaying an idempotency key with an identical body creates nothing new ...
A refused refund leaves the underlying rows unchanged.
The balances of one organisation, one environment, one currency sum to zero.
Each balance equals the sum of the signed amounts of the matching ledger entries.
The signed amounts of one ledger transaction sum to zero.
An amount is an integer in the minor unit travelling with a currency code.
A payout amount equals the sum of the net amounts of the listed transactions.
A dispute moves the disputed amount out of the available balance.
The API credential list never returns a secret value.
Creating an API credential returns the secret value exactly once.
A stored credential keeps only a hash plus a short display prefix.
A revoked credential stays listed rather than being removed.
A webhook address on a loopback host is refused with the code `endpoint_address_forbidden` ...
A webhook endpoint accepts only the nine named event types.
An executed refund request produces an approval-approved event plus a refund-created event.
Every mutation appends one audit record.
Audit sequence numbers rise by one per organisation with no gap ...
No route edits an audit record ...
A lead submission carrying a non-empty decoy field is refused ...
An unknown address answers not found ...
The gated product route carries the badge `Not available in your country` ...
The country home eyebrow reads `Global GDP running on Nimbus:` ...
The footer carries the locale label `India (English)` ...
Amounts render under Indian digit grouping.
The sandbox band carries the copy `Sandbox. No real money moves here.` ...
The country home bands appear in the stated order.
The primary storefront control carries the product plus the locale into the lead form.
Filter state on an index route lives in the address.
The lead form works with client scripting unavailable.
`/in` serves the country home ...
An anonymous request for a console address lands on the sign-in route ...
Every list carries an empty state naming what would appear there ...
The browser layer is SolidJS built with Vite ...
All timestamps are UTC ...
A ledger entry is never updated ...
The sum of non-failed refunds of a payment never exceeds the captured amount.
Seeding is idempotent across restarts ...
Display type scales continuously with the width of the window ...
No subscriptions, invoices, usage meters exist in the product ...
The app is reachable at `APP_PUBLIC_URL` ...
A list endpoint returns a top-level JSON array ...
